name: Shime (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shime town emblem in blue: a winged device above a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shime, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1979.

features.role: Shime town emblem — a winged device above a ring with a stylised character
